UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private Google-authenticated user profile for NexaAuth vault metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in user

name.description: Display name from Google profile or user override

avatar.description: Profile picture URL or preset identifier

authMethod.description: Authentication method used to sign in

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
